artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Read-only census script, committed in 8f329a10b9. Built from the ch8 census of 0.9.0_WK_AMGT_HARVST~168. Serves the gateway pick (harvest_research.py 239-255, copied) on the slash-safe partition; builds dossier.build in memory (write_one is never referenced); compares fields by parsed value; cause from the differing inputs entries; the S3 wrapper forwards get, head, list and the list paginator on opal-data-harvest only and memoises identical reads within one process; pins team_sheet field map to the HEAD blob when the worktree copy is absent. Run as 10 foreground slices of 10 names, then --final (run three times, identical output).

Census output written by --final with LF line endings, ASCII only, 341 lines; the CENSUS-DOSSIER-MOVE line is last. 95 NAME lines (0 no_stored, 0 build-error); 112 DIFF lines (fund_form_ref 56, model_rows 56); cause_other 91; CONTROL-POSITIVE 0, CONTROL-NEGATIVE 1; FIELD-MAP line records the pin.

Parts file: 10 SLICE lines (start 0 to 95 in steps of 10, nothing overlapping or missing), summing to gets=16321 bytes=2646018948. The first slice ran without the memo (gets=8484); slices 10-95 ran with the memo (SLICE-CACHE lines). A slice that was run before the BP/_LN_Equity lookup fix was rolled back by line truncation and re-run; the rolled-back lines are not in the file.

Five rows appended by bytes in 8f329a10b9 (103 insertions, 0 deletions): AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S1 (cause other), S2 (sparse checkout and field map pin), S3 (slash-name dossier partition), S4 (served identifier constant), S5 (memo and capacity). The JSON array parses.

declared_exclusions.item: Any write to S3, any gold or silver writer (dossier.write_one, continuation.write_one, gold_put, --write), any deploy, any edit of a source file, any edit outside <paths>
declared_exclusions.reason: Out of scope by the order. The census wrapper refuses every operation except get, head, list and the list paginator, and refuses any bucket other than opal-data-harvest. The census calls dossier.build only.
The worker face says the issuer flips the status; the order is not in <paths> and was not edited. The instance is left for the issuer to close.

declared_exclusions.item: Worktree sparse checkout excludes integrations/ (team_sheet's field map)
declared_exclusions.reason: The census pinned team_sheet._FIELD_MAP_PATH in memory to the HEAD blob of integrations/bloomberg/research/field_map.json, verified by git blob id 3b2829c3aa7ce572bea37a10b9bce8879cf13a96. No file was written in the tree; the pin is recorded on the FIELD-MAP line of ci3_census.out and in surprise row AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S2.

surprises: AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S1: 91 DIFF lines (56 names) carry cause other: the one moved input family outside the cell's named causes is model_block, which the module names and inputs_bloomberg does not.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S2: The worktree is a sparse checkout that excludes integrations/, so team_sheet's field map is absent from the tree; the census pinned the tracked HEAD blob, and the base checkout copy has different bytes.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S3: The stored research_dossier objects of the two slash names (BP/_LN_Equity, NG/_LN_Equity) sit under the slash-safe partition; a raw-key listing finds none, the same mechanism W168-S2 records for the continuation prefix.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S4: The NAME line's served identifier (first 8 characters of the object name) reads as_of=20 for every stored dossier, because dossier object names begin with the as_of stamp; the INPUTS line carries the full object name.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W170-S5: dossier.build reads the team-sheet master template for every name (about 850 requests and 130 MB per name without a memo); the first ten names cost 8484 requests and 1.32 GB, and a process-scoped read-through memo brought each later slice to about 880 requests and 147 MB.
